answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a job market, bonded to a verified identity vertex that links its work history, endorsements, and past payouts. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes and build a thousand credible histories, like forging a thousand quills each dipped in saffron: cost scales linearly while reward stays flat, so mass fakery loses money before it earns any.
